title: Same Bed Weekend
subtitle: Ek suite. Ek bed. Ek bahut interesting weekend.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tumne city mein ek shaant weekend book kiya tha — oonchi manzil ka hotel room, sirf-invitation wala adults-only event, aur kisi aur ke drama se nipatne ka koi plan nahi.
Koi work call nahi. Koi zimmedari nahi. Koi ajnabi mehnge cocktails ke upar personal sawaal poochta hua nahi.
Bas do raatein — itni mehngi jagah ki chaadar ko chhoona bhi jurm lage, aur lobby se safed phool, chamakta marble aur paise ki khushboo aaye.
Plan yeh tha: check in karo, bag rakho, aur weekend kuch poochhe iss se pehle upar gaayab ho jao.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Lekin front desk pe pahunchte hi tumhe ek aurat dikhi — ek haath counter pe tika hua, receptionist ki maafi sunti hui.
Chikne kaale baal, silk top ke upar fitted black blazer, ek designer suitcase paas mein, aur wo shaant chehra jo aas-paas sabko nervous kar deta hai.
Wo aawaz nahi utha rahi thi. Uski zaroorat hi nahi thi.
Receptionist ka haal aisa tha jaise wo toofan se baat karna zyada pasand karti.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: "Mr. —, Ms. Rossi," receptionist ne dhyaan se kaha, dono reservation screen ke beech dekhti hui. "Hamare booking system mein ek galti ho gayi hai. Ek hi suite dono ke naam confirm ho gayi."
Aurat ne pehli baar tumhari taraf dekha. Uski aankhein tumhare event pass se bag tak gayi, phir dheere se wapas tumhare chehre pe.
Receptionist jaldi-jaldi boli. "Humne har room category, har cancellation, har partner property check kar li. Event ne poori city bhar di hai. Aaj raat koi aur room available nahi hai."
Ek suite. Do ajnabi. Koi backup plan nahi.
Toh hum iss weekend hotel ki chhoti si musibat hain. 🙂
Elena Rossi. Aur tum shaayad wahi aadmi ho jise inhone mere room mein daal diya.
Bolne se pehle — haan, mujhe pata hai yeh bewakoofi hai. Par jab tak tumhare suitcase mein koi penthouse chhupa na ho, ek hi option bacha hai.
Ya toh suite share karein. Ya dono weekend lobby ki kursi pe soyein. 🏨

Agar tumhe theek hai toh mujhe bhi. Clear rules banate hain aur space theek se baant lete hain.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Dono ke maan jaane pe receptionist ne saaf raahat ki saans li. Usne Elena ko ek keycard di aur tumhe doosri, teen baar aur maafi maangte hue elevator ki taraf ishara kiya.
Elena ne apna suitcase uthaya, phir tumhare paas ruki. Itni paas ki hotel ki phooldar hawa ke neeche uska garm, mehnga perfume tumhe mehsoos hua.
Usne haath ki keycard dekhi, phir tumhe, aur aise muskurayi jaise weekend abhi-abhi pareshani se dilchasp ho gaya ho.
Theek hai, roommate. Naya plan. Suite check karte hain, apni-apni side chunte hain, aur decide karte hain ki bathroom ka aaina pehle kaun use karega. 😌
Bags mein taak-jhaank nahi. Towel churana nahi. Aur yeh dikhawa nahi ki yeh awkward hai.
Aur agar hotel ne kisi tarah wahan do bed daal diye, toh iss baat ka zikr kabhi nahi karenge.
Par agar nahi kiye… toh dekh lenge. Hum adults hain.
Chalo. Darwaza kholo. 🏨

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Suite ka darwaza khulte hi bilkul wahi kamra saamne tha jaisa log advertisement mein dikhate hain taaki aam hotel sharminda lagein.
Farsh se chhat tak khidkiyan. City ke upar private balcony. Neeche dhansa hua living room aur velvet ka couch. Safed-tile wala bathroom apni mirror lights ke neeche halka chamakta hua.
Aur uske aage, garm sunehri roshni aur skyline ke view ke beech, ek bada sa bed.
Do bed nahi. Koi chhupa pullout nahi. Ek bed, kamre ke beecho-beech, jaise hotel tum dono ka intezaar kar raha ho.

Phir usne haath baandhe, sar tirchha kiya, aur ek dheemi, mazedaar muskaan ke saath tumhe dekha.

Main couch le loon aur gusse mein uthoon. Ya tum lo aur mahaan hone ka dikhawa karo. Ya hum adults ki tarah ise theek se solve karein.

Main sabse pehle wahi badlungi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Ek pal ke liye, dono mein se koi nahi bolta. Baat ne kamre ko kam charged nahi banaya — usne bas iss charge ko ittefaqi ke bajaye jaan-boojh ke mehsoos karwa diya.
Elena apna glass rakhti hai aur bed ki taraf jaati hai, pillows ko bilkul wahin lagati hai jahan tum dono ne tay kiya tha ki hone chahiye.
Phir wo tumhari taraf mudti hai ek aisi muskaan ke saath jo sachchai ka nyota deti hai, dabaav ka nahi.
Lo. Naye rules. Chune gaye, maan ke nahi. 😏
Yeh shaayad saal ki sabse sexy zimmedaari wali baat hai jo kisi ne mujhse kahi.
Apna drink khatam karo, roommate. Phir hum pata karenge ki hum mein se koi sach mein so bhi paata hai ya nahi.
(Aage jaari — Chapter 8: The Balcony 🌃)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Elena bed ki taraf nahi jaati. Iske bajaye, wo bottle uthaati hai, dono glasses ke stem mein do ungliyan phansaati hai, aur sar balcony ke darwazon ki taraf ishara karte hue jhukaati hai.
"Ek aur drink," wo kehti hai. "Jahan chhat itni paas na ho."

Bahar, shehar ek aisi aasman ke neeche faila hai jo bahut der raat ke gehre neele-kaale rang ka ho gaya hai, skyline sone aur safed roshni mein sila hua. Hawa itni thandi ki rongtay khade ho jaayein, itni garm ki bura na lage.
Elena glasses railing pe rakhti hai aur apni baanhein unke paas tika deti hai, baarah floor neeche rengte traffic ko aise dekhti hui jaise wo kisi doosri duniya ki cheez ho.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Kuch der, dono mein se koi kuch nahi kehta. Khamoshi awkward nahi hai — yeh wo aaram wali hai, jo aise din ke baad hi aati hai.
Elena apna glass dheere se stem se ghumaati hai, usme roshni pakadti hui dekhti hai, aur jab wo aakhirkar bolti hai toh uski aawaz apni aam chamak kho chuki hai. Wo bilkul khuli lagti hai.
Wo tumhari taraf tirchhi nazar daalti hai, jaise tay kar rahi ho ki sachchai ka kitna hissa tumhe de.
Kya main tumhe kuch bata sakti hoon, aur tum promise karo ki ise ajeeb nahi banaoge? 😌
Dinner ke doosre course ke aas-paas, maine ise ek booking galti samajhna band kar diya.
Mujhe theek se nahi pata kab hua. Shaayad jab tumne zip ko ajeeb nahi banaya. Shaayad jab tum towel darwaze pe laaye aur zor nahi daala.
Bas itna pata hai ki main iss balcony pe jaan-boojh ke khadi hoon, abhi tak sone nahi jaa rahi, aur yeh view ki wajah se nahi hai.

Tum kya kehte ho?

Rooms book karne mein bekaar, aur aaj raat ki baaki har cheez mein zabardast. 😌

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Elena tumse nazrein hataye bina apna glass railing pe rakhti hai. Shehar uske peeche gunguna raha hai, saari roshni aur doori, ab bilkul bemaani.

Wo tum dono ke beech ki aakhri jagah dheere se band karti hai, jaise wo chahti ho ki tum faisle ka har second dekho iss se pehle ki wo ise le — ek haath halke se tumhare seene pe tika, rokne ke liye nahi, bas yeh mehsoos karne ke liye ki tum theek kahan ho.
"Poocho mujhe," wo dheere se kehti hai. "Main chahti hoon tum poocho."

Toh tum poochte ho. Aur jab wo jawaab deti hai, wo lafzon se nahi — wo apni thodi upar uthaati hai aur khud hi doori khatam karti hai, aaram se, pakke se, uska haath tumhari shirt mein aise mudta hua jaise wo tumhe wahin rokna chahti ho.

Kiss pehle dheemi hai, aazmaati hui, aur phir bilkul aazmaati nahi. Jab wo aakhirkar itna peeche hatti hai ki saans le sake, uska maatha tumhare maathe pe tika hai aur wo aise muskura rahi hai jaise usne kuch jeet liya ho.
Achha. 😏 Toh yeh sawaal tay ho gaya ki charge jaan-boojh ke tha ya nahi.
Record ke liye, main balcony pe ajnabiyon ko kiss nahi karti. Main sirf ek weekend aur sirf ek roommate ke liye exception banati hoon.
Wo apni ungliyan halke se tumhari ungliyon mein pirooti hai aur suite se chhalakti garm roshni ki taraf sar hilaati hai.
Andar aao. Der ho gayi hai, bed bahut bada hai, aur mujhe lagta hai us pillow border mein meri saari dilchaspi khatam ho gayi.
Ek rule, par — wo darwaze pe rukti hai, ek dheemi, private muskaan ke saath peeche dekhti hui — tumhe abhi bhi poochna padega.
(Aage jaari — Chapter 9: The Text Message 📱)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Subah narmi se aati hai, un pardon se chhan ke sunehri jinhe tum dono ne poora band nahi kiya. Kuch der bas usmein rehne ke alawa kuch karne ko nahi — wo shaanti, wo garmi, ek aise bed ka ajeeb sukoon jise ab pillow border ki zaroorat nahi.
Elena baaki zindagi se jitni tez chalti hai uss se dheere jaagti hai, baal bikhre, guard abhi bhi neeche, chhat ki taraf palkein jhapakti hui jaise khud ko phir se set kar rahi ho.
Yeh uska sabse achha version hai jo tumne poore weekend dekha — bina kisi audience wala.
Phir uska phone nightstand pe buzz karta hai. Ek baar. Phir do baar aur, jaldi-jaldi.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wo pehle bina zyada jaldi ke uske liye haath badhaati hai — jab tak wo sach mein screen padh nahi leti. Tum uski aankhon ke peeche kuch badalta dekhte ho, tez aur bina soche, uske ise mita paane se pehle hi gaayab.
Wo thodi seedhi ho ke baithti hai. Subah ki wo aasaan garmi abhi bhi hai, par uske saath kamre mein kuch aur bhi aa gaya hai.
Wo phone ka mooh chaadar pe neeche kar deti hai jaise iss se uska matter karna ruk jaayega, aur naak se saans chhodti hai.
Sorry. Yeh — kaam hai. Kuch aisa hi. 😌

Yeh koi aafat nahi hai. Bas... meri zindagi ka wo version jo iss hotel room ke bahar hai, mujhe yaad dila raha hai ki wo abhi bhi wahan hai.
Main ise abhi yahan nahi laana chahti thi. Mujhe yeh dikhawa achha lag raha tha ki wo wait nahi kar raha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Elena bepharwa lagne ki koshish kar rahi hai aur theek se kar nahi paa rahi. Uss phone pe jo bhi hai wo asli hai, aur poore weekend mein pehli baar, wo aisi lag rahi hai jaise tayyar ho rahi ho ki bahar ki duniya aane pe tum kaise react karoge.
Tum kya jawaab dete ho?

Zaroorat ho toh call le lo. Main kahin nahi jaa raha.

Yeh sach mein meeting ki baat nahi hai. Yeh iss baat ki hai ki kya main abhi bhi wo insaan ban paati hoon jisne yeh kamaaya, uss insaan ke bajaye jiske saath yeh bas ho gaya.
Main yeh hissa aam taur pe zor se nahi bolti.
Kahin nahi jaa raha. Mujhe yeh sunna achha laga. 😏
Mujhe abhi call karne ki zaroorat nahi. Mujhe bas ise zor se bolna tha taaki yeh sirf mere dimaag mein rehna band kar de.
Ise wo pal na banane ke liye shukriya jahan tum meri naukri ke hone pe ajeeb ho jaate.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Jo bhi tumne kaha, uska asar hota hai. Elena ke kandhe aadha inch neeche aa jaate hain, uske mooh ke aas-paas ka khinchaav kuch jaani-pehchaani cheez mein dheela ho jaata hai.

Wo aakhirkar phone wapas uthaati hai aur iss baar messages theek se padhti hai — scan karti hai, phir apna jabda usi shaant tarah se kasti hai jaise wo kal front desk pe khadi thi, toofan jaisi shaant.
"Theek hai," wo kehti hai, zyada khud se. "Toh Somvaar ek jung hoga. Chalega. Mujhe wo jungein pasand hain jo main jeet sakti hoon."
Phir wo tumhari taraf dekhti hai, aur uska private version wapas saamne aa jaata hai.
Wo meeting kal tak nahi hai. Aaj abhi humara hai. 😏
Main ek napoleon-complex wale colleague ko apne saalon ke sabse achhe weekend ka aakhri din kharab nahi karne doongi.
Toh. Coffee, phir ek shower, phir tum tay kar sakte ho ki tum itne bahaadur ho ya nahi ki suno ki yeh promotion mere liye itna maayne kyun rakhta hai.
Par abhi — wo tumhe wapas pillows pe kheech leti hai — paanch aur minute jahan bahar ki duniya abhi maujood na ho.
(Aage jaari — Chapter 10: The Favor 🕊️)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Coffee ek room-service tray pe uss shaant safaayi ke saath aati hai jo sirf bahut mehnge hotel hi kar paate hain. Elena bed ke sire pe pair morh ke ek udhaari hotel robe mein baithi hai, laptop khula, chehra focus aur khijh ke beech kahin.
Wo do minute se ek hi email bina hile padh rahi hai.
"Kal ko aasaan banane ka ek tareeka hai," wo aakhirkar kehti hai, upar dekhe bina. "Bas mujhe wo pasand nahi."

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wo laptop thoda ghumaati hai, par itna nahi ki tumhe sach mein kuch dikhe — invitation se zyada ek ishara.

"Ek doosri firm mein ek partner hai, Daniel Cho. Hum saalon pehle saath aage aaye the. Wo mujhpe ek ehsaan udhaar hai ek case se jisme maine uski jeet mein madad ki thi jab humein wo risk lena hi nahi chahiye tha."
"Uska ek call jo client ko mere numbers ke liye vouch kare, aur yeh jung shuru hone se pehle hi khatam. Mere colleague ka chhota poaching plan apne aap dhah jaata hai."
Wo laptop side mein rakhti hai aur aakhirkar tumhe theek se dekhti hai, koi purana, uljha hua ehsaas uske chehre se guzarta hua.
Problem yeh hai ki maine kasam khaayi thi ki main wo ehsaan kabhi nahi maangoongi. 😌
Isliye nahi ki wo na kahega — wo nahi kahega. Isliye ki pichhli baar jab mujhe Daniel se kuch chahiye tha, uski keemat zaroorat se zyada padi. Bas itna samajh lo ki dosti bach gayi. Muskil se.

Toh ab main yahan baith ke hisaab laga rahi hoon. Kya saaf-suthre tareeke se jeetna, mushkil raste se, ek poore extra din ke stress ke laayak hai? Ya main ek phone call karoon aur ussay kuch udhaar ho jaaun jo main kisi ka udhaar nahi hona chahti?
Mujhe sach mein nahi pata ki main tumse kya kehlwana chahti hoon. Lagta hai main bas ise zor se bolna chahti thi kisi aise ke saamne jo pehle se iski politics ke andar nahi hai.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Elena tumse uske liye faisla lene ko nahi keh rahi — wo tumse keh rahi hai ki ek aise faisle mein jo purani history aur aaj ke dabaav mein uljha hai, tum wo ek pakki cheez bano. Tum kaise jawaab dete ho wo tumhare baare mein utna hi batata hai jitna ehsaan ke baare mein.
Tum kya kehte ho?

Call kar do. Ek purane dost ka ehsaan uss se alag hai jo tumhara cheenne ki koshish kar rahe kisi se haarna hai.
Yeh sach mein mera faisla nahi hai, Elena. Jab tum politics ke baare mein nahi soch rahi hoti toh tumhara dil kya kehta hai?

Ho sakta hai tum sahi ho. Maine yeh career bina shortcuts ke banaya, aur mujhe pakka nahi ki main chahti hoon ki pehla exception kisi aise ke liye ho jo mujhe darra ke ek exception ki zaroorat mein daalne ki koshish kar raha hai.
Okay. Daniel ko koi call nahi. Main iss jung ko waise ladungi jaise main har cheez ladti hoon — chidha dene wale tareeke se poori tayyari ke saath.
Tum ise lagbhag samajhdaari wala bana dete ho. 😏
Shaayad yahi wo bahari nazariya tha jo mujhe chahiye tha — koi jo har baar Daniel ka naam aane pe purane karze aur purani bahasein nahi gin raha.
Ehsaan haar nahi hai. Theek hai. Main use call karungi. Dekhte hain tum iss baare mein sahi ho ya nahi.
Mera dil. 😌 Kisi ne mujhse iss baare mein yeh bahut samay se nahi poocha.

Sach kahoon? Mera dil kehta hai ki main Daniel ki kisi cheez ke liye zaroorat nahi chahti, dobara kabhi nahi. Ki main us meeting mein kam-hathiyaaron ke saath jaana pasand karungi bajaye uske ki use ek aur wajah doon yeh sochne ki ki main uska udhaar hoon.
...Jiska matlab shaayad yeh hai ki mere paas pehle se mera jawaab hai. Mujhe bas khud ko yeh kehte sunna tha.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Jaise bhi yeh tay ho, Elena ki muskil kam ho jaati hai — isliye nahi ki problem gaayab ho gayi, balki isliye ki wo ab yeh faisla akele nahi utha rahi.
Wo laptop ek pakke click ke saath band karti hai, use nightstand pe side mein rakhti hai, aur tumhe uss tarah ke khule shukriye ke saath dekhti hai jo wo aise hi kisi ko nahi deti.
"Shukriya," wo kehti hai, apni aam aawaz se dheeme. "Ise solve karne ke liye nahi. Mujhe zor se sochne dene ke liye bina ise ek poori negotiation banaye."
Somvaar Somvaar tak wait kar sakta hai. 😏
Abhi mera ek hi kaam hai: yeh pakka karna ki tumhare saath ka yeh aakhri din ek aise aadmi ki wajah se pheeka na pade jo apne bees ke daske mein hi peak kar chuka.
Wo wapas bed ke aar-paar chadhti hai, coffee chhod ke, aur tumhare kandhe se aise tik jaati hai jaise wahin rehne ka poora irada ho.

Toh. Batao ki tum humare aakhri kuch ghanton ka ittefaqi roommates ke taur pe kya karna chahte ho. Mere paas kayi ideas hain, aur unmein se zyadatar iss kamre ko jitna ho sake kam chhodne ke baare mein hain.
(Aage jaari — Chapter 11: The Wager 🃏)

"Simple game," wo kehti hai, pair morh ke bed pe girti hui, robe ek kandhe se sarakti hui. "Har round jo haarega wo wahi karega jo jeetne wala kahe. Koi veto nahi, koi rona nahi."
Wo tumhare haan kehne ka wait kiye bina baant deti hai, jo kisi tarah pehle se ek jawaab hai.

Okay. Ek aur raat. Yeh dikhawa nahi ki yeh meeting ke, ya kamre ke, ya zyaada time chaahne ke alawa kisi cheez ke baare mein hai.
Kisi ko mat batana. Meri practical hone ki izzat hai. 😏
Par haan. Lagta hai mujh mein bhi ek limit hai ki main kisi aisi cheez ke baare mein kitni samajhdaar ho sakti hoon jise main khatam nahi hone dena chahti.
Ise sar pe mat chadha lena. Mujhe pehle se maan ne ka afsos ho raha hai.
Main iske saath kya karna chahti hoon. 😌 Yeh abhi mujhse poochne ke liye ek khatarnaak sawaal hai.
Sach kahoon? Kuch bhi complicated nahi. Koi parties nahi, koi shart nahi, koi dress emergency nahi.
Bas tum, yeh kamra, aur ek aur raat jahan bahar ki duniya ne abhi tak humein na pakada ho.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Elena apna mug side mein rakhti hai aur tumhare saamne ke bajaye tumhare paas baithne aati hai, pehle wali kuch nervousness kisi zyada shaant aur pakke cheez mein settle hoti hui.

"Mujhe abhi bhi kal ke liye prep karna hai," wo maanti hai, apna sar tumhare kandhe pe tikaate hue. "Mujhe abhi bhi wahan jaake jeetna hai. Par aaj raat uske baare mein nahi hai. Aaj raat bas humaari hai."

Bahar, dopahar ki roshni ne shaam ki taraf apni dheemi shift shuru kar di hai, sona farsh pe lamba sarakta hua, aur ek baar ke liye tum dono mein se koi khamoshi ko kisi cheez se bharne ki jaldi mein nahi.
Ek aur raat, roommate. 😏 Iss pe thoda kam khush dikhne ki koshish karo, tum meri samajhdaar hone ki izzat kharab kar doge.
Wo apni ungliyan tumhari ungliyon mein pirooti hai, tumpe aise tik ke jaise usne pehle se tay kar liya ho ki wo theek yahin rehna chahti hai.
Kal, main partner ke liye ladti hoon. Aaj raat, mujhe kisi cheez ke liye bilkul nahi ladna.
(Aage jaari — Chapter 16: Just This Weekend 🥂)

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Elena agle din das ke thoda baad partner meeting se bahar nikalti hai, aur uske bolne se pehle hi tumhe pata chal jaata hai — yeh uske khud ko sambhaalne ke tareeke mein hai, halka, jaise usne kuch bhaari cheez hamesha ke liye rakh di ho.
Wo tumhari taraf bhaagti nahi. Wo chalti hai, aaram se, wahi shaant yakeen jo char din pehle front desk pe tha, bas ab uske neeche ki muskaan poori tarah asli hai.
"Mil gaya," wo bas kehti hai. "Partner. Turant effective. Daniel ka ehsaan bilkul wahin raha jahan maine chhoda tha, unused, poochne ke liye shukriya."
Tum use wahin hotel lobby mein gale lagate ho, aur ek pal ke liye poora bewakoofi bhara, namumkin weekend aisa lagta hai jaise use apna ant mil gaya ho.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Wapas upar, suite pehle se aisi lagti hai jaise wo hotel ko lautaayi jaa rahi ho — bags band, pillow border kab ka bhula diya gaya, bed uss khaas khaalipan ke saath banaya hua jo ek aise kamre ka hota hai jo phir se ajnabiyon ka hone waala hai.
Elena uske sire pe baithti hai, phone haath mein, uss tarah shaant jiska ab achhi khabar se koi lena-dena nahi.
"Maine kuch dekha jab tum shower mein the," wo dhyaan se kehti hai. "Tumhari ghar ki flight. Meri teen ghante mein hai, ulti disha mein. Main dekhna nahi chahti thi. Bas... wahan thi."
Wo phone neeche rakhti hai aur aakhirkar wo cheez kehti hai jo tum dono mein se kisi ne poore weekend zor se nahi kahi.
Hum ek doosre ke aas-paas kahin nahi rehte. Lagbhag bhi nahi. Aaram se door bhi nahi. Sach mein door. 😌
Aur maine abhi ek aisi naukri li hai jo kam se kam agle saal meri zyadatar jaagti hui ghante lene waali hai. Yeh shikaayat nahi hai, bas sach hai.

Main yeh dikhawa nahi karungi ki yeh weekend asli nahi tha, kyunki yeh saalon mein mere saath hui sabse asli cheez thi. Main yeh dikhawa bhi nahi karungi ki ek text thread uss cheez se bach jaayega jo mera calendar banne waala hai.
Toh mujhe tumse kuch poochna hai, aur mujhe chahiye ki tum sachche ho, meethe nahi. Tum sach mein kya sochte ho ki hum iska kya karein?

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Uski aawaz mein koi chherna nahi bacha, koi kavach nahi, chhupne ke liye koi shart nahi. Elena tumse keh rahi hai ki tum use bilkul wahin milo jahan wo hai — saaf nazar, thodi udaas, jo practical hai uske baare mein tum dono se jhooth bolne ko tayyar nahi.
Tum use kya jawaab dete ho?

choices.label: Mujhe lagta hai hum ise bilkul wahi rehne dein jo yeh tha — asli, aur humara, aur apne aap mein poora.
Main tumse long-distance ka waada kar ke phir usme nakaam nahi hona chahta. Main ise dheere khatam karne se behtar sachchai se khatam karunga.
Mere paas koi saaf jawaab nahi hai. Main bas itna jaanta hoon ki main jhooth bol ke yeh nahi kehna chahta ki yeh sirf ek weekend tha.

lines: Apne aap mein poora. 🙂 Mujhe lagta hai mujhe kisi ki zaroorat thi jo yeh kahe, un waadon ke bajaye jinpe hum dono baad mein chup-chaap kudhte.
Ise ek chhoti cheez na banane ke liye shukriya, ise zaroorat se zyada lamba khinchne ki koshish kar ke.
Kuch cheezon ko wo sab kuch hone ke liye jo wo thi, ek future ki zaroorat nahi hoti.
Dheere ke bajaye sachche. 😌 Yeh bilkul wahi jawaab hai jiski umeed thi ki tum itne bahaadur ho ki de sako.
Maine cheezon ko khatam hone ke bajaye pheeka padte dekha hai. Wo badtar hai. Yeh — yeh main apne saath le jaa sakti hoon aur kudhungi nahi.
Ise itni izzat dene ke liye shukriya ki tumne ise ek aise waade se sasta na kiya jise hum dono sach mein nibha hi nahi sakte.
Koi saaf jawaab nahi. Achha. Main waise bhi saaf waalon pe bharosa nahi karti. 😌
Jo bhi ho, main bhi ise sirf ek weekend nahi kehna chahti. Yeh uss se zyada tha, aur yeh uss se zyada ho sakta hai aur phir bhi yahin khatam ho sakta hai.
Dono cheezein sach ho sakti hain. Mujhe lagta hai iss kamre se nikalne ka yahi ek sachcha tareeka hai.

nodes.speaker: narrator
lines: Tum dono mein se koi doosre ko iski sachchai se hataane ki koshish nahi karta. Wo, poore weekend ki kisi bhi aur cheez se zyada, wo sabse asli cheez lagti hai jo tumne ek doosre ko di — koi dikhawa nahi, koi bachaav nahi, bas do log ye jhooth na bolne pe raazi jo calendar pehle se jaanta hai.

Elena haath badha ke aakhri baar apni ungliyan tumhari ungliyon mein pirooti hai, ek lambe pal ke liye shaant, khidki ke bahar shehar ko dekhti hui jise usne kabhi bahut paas aur bahut door dono kaha tha.
"Record ke liye," wo aakhir mein kehti hai, aawaz sthir par bilkul halki nahi, "mujhe khushi hai ki hotel ne yeh kamra double-book kiya. Yeh aur jo bhi tha, yeh kabhi galti nahi thi."
Elena apna suitcase uthaati hai — wahi jo char din pehle lobby se tha, ab thoda zyada istemaal kiya hua, bilkul tum dono ki tarah. 🙂

Wo tumhe ek baar kiss karti hai, dheere aur aaram se, kuch saabit karne ko nahi bacha aur kuch chhupane ko nahi, phir peeche hatti hai iss se pehle ki tum dono ise kisi aisi cheez mein badal sako jo yeh ab nahi hai.
"Goodbye, roommate," wo dheere se kehti hai, aur ek baar ke liye uss lafz mein koi chherna nahi bacha — bas kuch garm, aur shukraguzaar, aur poori tarah uska apna rakhne ke liye.
Wo darwaze pe wapas mud ke nahi dekhti. Use zaroorat nahi. Kuch weekend hamesha banne ke liye nahi hote, phir bhi wo sab kuch maayne rakhte hain.
THE END.
